instruction: Create a NEW original, pure-Dart reusable package named aivexus_delta_codec, SDK >=3.3.0 <4.0.0, code at lib/delta_codec.dart and behavioral tests under test/. Implement exactly two public functions: List<int> encodeDeltas(List<int> samples), encoding the first sample unchanged and each later entry as current minus previous; List<int> decodeDeltas(List<int> deltas), reconstructing original sample values. Return fresh lists, never mutate arguments. Empty input gives empty output; negative values must work. No external runtime dependencies, network, IO, shell or FFI. Return only the strict JSON files object specified by the system prompt.
